decisions.reason: As a core formwork profile line with a prior dedicated page, its option value remains high and keeping costs are low despite no recent web presence.
The automated concrete distributor flow control builds on the established offer and aligns with the firm's automation strategy, so its option value justifies continued low-cost retention.
The shuttering magnet block line has shown no website presence for two years and is not strategically distinct enough to keep as an option, so we drop it.
With multiple models and a dedicated page, the magnetic formwork strips still have unresolved upside and low keeping costs, so we keep the option open.
As a single magnetic component with no web presence and only a mention initially, its value is unlikely to be realized, so we drop it and reallocate resources.
